status: proposed syntax refinement, not adopted or implemented; accepted quoted prompt carriers and current drafts are not rewritten
human_suggestion: Use a visible marker such as $"prompt" because build-time code generation can cost money.
recommendation: Use $"..." as one consistent static generation-prompt literal in Given, When and Then. Ordinary "..." stays text/metadata. Existing owner headers determine target, type and output; the marker does not define a separate generation engine.
lexical_form: A dollar sign immediately followed by a JSON double-quoted string; preserve the existing JSON escape and Unicode rules. $ "..." is invalid. No interpolation, runtime evaluation or message-variant suffix.
candidate_source_forms: trait completable $"Add the declared completion fields and supported rules."
do $"Stage the declared task update through the canonical effects."
style $"A calm layout with readable spacing; stack on narrow screens."
style TaskList $"Readable task rows and visible keyboard focus."
view TaskTile(row:Task) $"Arrange admitted task fields and declared controls."
invariant Booking: $"Active bookings for the same desk must not overlap."
policy Claim read=reviewer where=$"Only claims at assigned locations."
lock Invoice fields=total,currency when=$"Once the invoice has been issued."

rule append_only $"Make the target record immutable after creation."
append_only Movement
given_rule_scope: The broader rule/predicate targets above remain the separate proposed extension in design/proposals/given-rule-prompts/proposal.json, including unresolved typing, phase and dependency contracts; the marker does not adopt them.
generation_and_cost: The literal marks a discoverable generation unit/intent, not an instruction to charge or invoke a coding tool whenever a build visits it.
Explicit selected-unit generation/fresh/refine/retry may invoke the configured coding CLI/model, using its existing bounded controls and truthful available usage/cost reporting.
Ordinary build/check uses saved compatible files with zero AI calls. Missing/stale files diagnose and identify the unit; they do not silently generate.
Keep independently selected units, tracked current files, direct refinement, cooperative leases and reset-preserves-current semantics unchanged.
non_generation_contexts: Prompt literals are invalid as ordinary runtime string values, labels, descriptions, translation/message variants or arbitrary expressions. A specifically supported generated default/derive/rule slot requires its owning typed contract. Dollar signs within ordinary strings/comments remain content.
verified_current_facts: Canonical lexer has no authored dollar punctuation. Today the prefix is rejected as E1007 followed by ordinary STRING token; no new lexer behavior is claimed.
Targeted examples/compiler-fixture authored .can scans found no dollar-sign use. Compiler-generated $cohort metadata is unrelated to authored prompt syntax.
Canonical grammar has static JSON strings and no source string interpolation; the proposal preserves that distinction.
open_decisions: Human adoption of the marker and exact supported generation slots; broader Given rule carrier/phase/dependency decisions remain separate.

If adopted, revise the accepted source-carrier requirements/choices and authoring samples before implementing BGI grammar. No compatibility alias is required merely for an unimplemented draft surface.
implementation_scope: Design record only: no compiler/runtime, draft corpus migration, provider invocation or new generation control in this change.
